column1: # clues.tsv for ft_ultimate_div_mod — hints only, never answers.

The quotient has to end up in the int a points to, and the remainder in the one b points to. Both are computed from the values a and b pointed to when the call began: when your code computes the second result, does it still have them?
When a negative number is involved, what sign does the remainder take and which way does division round?
